noise.label: Noise Editor
noise.description: Create a 2D or 3D resource. Edit source, seed, transforms and ordered processing. Apply commits only valid definitions; shared resources retain their own settings when used in a layer.

layers.label: World Generator
layers.description: Generation starts EMPTY. Layers run from top to bottom. Each placement inherits absent properties live; Override stores only that placement's property, and Reset removes it. SET, CLEAR and NO_CHANGE evaluate previous committed voxel state.

navigation.label: Navigation
navigation.description: 3D: left drag orbits, right drag pans, middle drag moves X/Z, Ctrl+middle moves Y, wheel zooms. Ctrl+click enters free-fly. WASD, Space and Shift move; Escape releases capture. Teleport changes coordinates only.

save.label: Projects
save.description: New, Open and Exit ask Save / Don't Save / Cancel when dirty. Save validates then writes a temporary sibling and atomically replaces the destination where supported. No autosave or recent project list.

processing.label: Processing and expressions
processing.description: Inputs explicitly select constants, shared parameters, ambient variables, source, earlier results or noise references. Scalar/Boolean expressions are typed, bounded and stateless. Power is right associative; &&, || and ?: short circuit. Invalid numeric domains fail the sample.

archives.label: Voxel archives
archives.description: Archives store compressed adaptive chunks and a semantic voxel ID dictionary. Coverage distinguishes omitted EMPTY payloads from unarchived coordinates. Rendering quality never changes exact data.

bookmarks.label: Bookmarks
bookmarks.tooltip: Separate coordinate lists for each tab
bookmarks.description: Bookmarks store only coordinates and a name. Adding, renaming, updating or deleting is an undoable project edit; teleporting never dirties the document.
